title: Recon Optimisation Check - MNase test
body:
### 1. MNase testing of TW, YY samples

NanoDrop quant:

TW: 136 ng/uL*

YY: 98 ng/uL*

**Not entirely certain how accurate these values are*

dMNase → 1:1000 dilution


| Reagent | Volume |
| :---- | :---- |
| DNA | 10-15 ng |
| MNase Buffer | 5 uL |
| rAlbumin | 0.25 uL |
| dMNase | 1 uL |
| TOTAL | 50 uL |

For TW = 5 uL sample
For YY = 7 uL sample

Treat at 37 C, 5 mins.

Run on a 2% agarose gel and stain with SYBR Green.
experiments: 1. MNase testing of TW, YY samples
